categories.main_business_segments: Range Intelligent Computing Technology Group primarily operates in the integrated computing power center sector, focusing on investment, construction, ownership, and operation of high-grade, efficient, high-performance, and green computing power centers. Its main business includes IDC (Internet Data Center) services and AIDC (Artificial Intelligence Data Center) services, providing hosting, management, and intelligent computing services to leading internet, cloud, and AI customers. The company has established multiple computing power infrastructure clusters across six major regions in China.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as liquid cooling for high-density computing, AI-driven intelligent operation and maintenance platforms, and green energy solutions to enhance energy efficiency and reduce carbon footprint. It employs a 'self-invest, self-build, self-own, self-operate' model for its computing centers, integrating cutting-edge AI computing architectures and proprietary software platforms for real-time monitoring and management. The firm also develops AI-powered inspection robots and smart water management systems to optimize data center operations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major telecommunications operators, leading internet companies, top cloud service providers, prominent AI clients, and certain national government departments. The company serves industries requiring large-scale, stable, and secure computing power, such as AI training and inference, cloud computing, and digital economy sectors. Its markets are primarily in China, focusing on regions with high demand for advanced computing infrastructure.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates across six major regions in China: the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei area (Langfang), Yangtze River Delta (Pinghu), Greater Bay Area (Foshan and Huizhou), Chengdu-Chongqing economic zone (Chongqing), Northwest China (Lanzhou), and Hainan Free Trade Port (Danzhou). It has established seven AIDC infrastructure clusters with a total planned capacity of approximately 320,000 cabinets nationwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: Range Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the computing power supply chain, focusing on the investment, construction, and operation of data centers and intelligent computing centers. It collaborates with upstream equipment suppliers and downstream telecom operators and end customers, acting as a comprehensive solution provider and operator of integrated computing infrastructure.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation driven by R&D, focusing on green and low-carbon technologies, liquid cooling systems, AI-enabled intelligent operation and maintenance, and full-stack AI computing ecosystems. It aims to upgrade existing low-power data centers, accelerate deployment of high-density and liquid-cooled cabinets, and expand its AI computing services. Strategic priorities include building a nationwide integrated computing power network, enhancing operational capabilities, and expanding market share through organic growth and acquisitions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of IDC and AIDC services, including hosting, management, and intelligent computing services. The company operates primarily on a wholesale model in IDC, partnering with telecom operators who provide bandwidth and bill end customers, while Range Technology receives service fees based on cabinet usage. AIDC revenues come from providing AI training, inference, and application services to leading AI clients, with income recognized upon delivery of services or products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Range Technology is positioned as a leading player in China's integrated computing power center industry, recognized for its nationwide strategic layout and technological leadership in liquid cooling and AI data centers. It competes in a fragmented market with many entrants, especially in the emerging AIDC sector, but maintains competitive advantages through scarce resource control, large-scale park-level data centers, and strong customer trust. The company aims to consolidate market share via horizontal acquisitions and innovation to strengthen its industry dominance.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 4.36 billion, a slight increase of 0.32% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 1.79 billion, up 1.62%. Total assets grew by 34.31% to over RMB 31.3 billion, with net assets reaching nearly RMB 10 billion. The company has demonstrated steady growth with expanding computing center deployments and increasing cash flow generation, supported by substantial financing and capital investments in new generation AI computing centers.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Range Technology emphasizes its unique value through its nationwide integrated computing power center system, combining high-grade, efficient, and green infrastructure with advanced liquid cooling technology. Its 'four-self' model (self-invest, self-build, self-own, self-operate) ensures stable, secure, and reliable services, fostering deep trust with major internet and AI customers. The company’s pioneering liquid cooling solutions and full-stack AI computing ecosystem differentiate it by enabling high-density, energy-efficient, and intelligent computing services aligned with national digital and carbon reduction strategies.
